title: 第五章 幻网通
slug: 不正经的异世界攻略手册
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

夜晚，伊尔莎躺在了自己房间的床上，看着陌生的天花板。

完全想象不到，前两天，她还是帝国王女，在经历了惨烈疯狂的王位争夺战后，本该大势已去，迎接自己的结局，但现在却被陌生人收养，到了人类王国，隐姓埋名，躺在这偏僻乡下的小屋内。

“那家伙...到底有什么目的啊....”

伊尔莎喃喃自语道。

本来还以为他就是个luoli控变态，收养她就是为了满足恶趣味，本来到了他家里都准备好接受各种不堪入目的待遇了，但到目前为止却一切正常。

甚至，她在刚才洗澡，上厕所的时候，都仔细的检查过了浴室和卫生间内有没有隐蔽式监控类的魔法，还有自己的房间，全都检查了一遍，但什么都没有发现。

作为王女她也接受过反侦察训练，就连最高等阶的监视魔法她都能找出来，但却一无所获，那没有就肯定是没有了。

还有一件事让她很在意。

刚才在吃饭的时候，亚枫为她准备了酸茶酱，这是一种很小众的酱汁，入口酸涩，却带有回甘，是伊尔莎过去外出时意外品尝到的，十分喜爱便带回了王宫，用餐时都喜欢用这个酱汁。

但它的受众很少，很多人都没听说过，而且除了她的宫廷厨师和贴身侍女外也没人知道她有这口味，难道说亚枫也喜欢这种酱汁？

但是看他盘里，却是普通的辣酱，自己这份像是特意为她准备的。

除此之外，连为她准备的衣服也都是合身尺码，还有她房间的窗帘是深蓝色带月亮花图案的，窗台上还摆放着一株子夜菊，在她王宫的房间内，也有着一株她养了快十年的子夜菊，这些都是她私人的喜好。

难道，他之前还是专门调查过自己？把她的各种喜好都调查的一清二楚？

而且，他还提前得到了魔族政变的消息，提前就准备好了这一切，等待着将她接回家。

仔细想想，真有种毛骨悚然的感觉...

实际上，虽然伊尔莎自己很担心，但对亚枫来说，这些却并不是什么新鲜事。

在上一世里他照顾了这位王女十年，为了能让她认真修炼，真就和当爹似的料理她上上下下的生活起居，王女每天内衣都是他来洗的，所以别说这些小偏门的爱好，就连她周一到周六每天都会穿固定款式的内裤这件事都一清二楚，

伊尔莎有些困了，前段时间一直都保持着高强度的紧张状态，虽然现在的环境对她来说有些奇怪，但却给了她难得的安心感，至少，不用担心睡到一半床边就会冒出行刺的侩子手了，亚枫看样子暂时也不会对她出手，

对她来说，身为帝国王女的日子，要告一段落了...

她的眼皮愈发沉重，很快就睡了过去。

....

朦朦胧胧中，她好像看到了亚枫，但是却并不是现在的摸样。

而是身穿铠甲，留着黑色长发，目光出奇的坚毅和沉稳，对待她还带着一股长辈般的不容置疑的威严。

自己也不是现在的摸样，而是穿着费因高等术师的长袍，留着短发，面对亚枫时心情却止不住的紧张，都不敢轻易开口说话，只有满心的敬畏与忠诚。

At night, Ilsa lay on the bed in her room, looking at the unfamiliar ceiling.

It was completely unimaginable that two days ago, she was still the princess of the empire. After experiencing a fierce and crazy battle for the throne, she should have been over it and welcomed her own end, but now she was adopted by a stranger, came to the human kingdom, and lay anonymously in this small house in the remote countryside.

"That guy...what is his purpose..."

Ilsa murmured.

I originally thought that he was a licentious pervert who adopted her just to satisfy his evil taste. I was ready to accept all kinds of unsavory treatment when she arrived at his home, but so far everything has been normal.

Even when she took a shower and went to the toilet just now, she carefully checked whether there was any hidden surveillance magic in the bathroom and toilet. She also checked her own room, but found nothing.

As a princess, she has also received counter-reconnaissance training. She can find out even the highest level of surveillance magic, but she finds nothing.

There was one more thing that concerned her.

While eating just now, Yafeng prepared sour tea sauce for her. This is a very niche sauce that is sour in the mouth but has a sweet aftertaste. Ilsa accidentally tasted it when she went out in the past. She liked it so much that she brought it back to the palace. She also likes to use this sauce during her meals.

But its audience is very small, many people have never heard of it, and no one except her palace chef and personal maid knows that she has this taste. Could it be said that Ya Feng also likes this kind of sauce?

But looking at what he had on his plate, it was just ordinary hot sauce. It seemed like he had specially prepared it for her.

In addition, even the clothes prepared for her were of a suitable size, the curtains in her room were dark blue with a moonflower pattern, and there was a midnight chrysanthemum on the windowsill. In her room in the palace, there was also a midnight chrysanthemum that she had raised for almost ten years. These were all her personal preferences.

Could it be that he had specifically investigated himself before?Investigate all her preferences thoroughly?

Moreover, he also received the news of the demon clan's coup in advance, prepared everything in advance, and was waiting to take her home.

Thinking about it carefully, it feels really creepy...

In fact, although Ilsa herself was worried, these were nothing new to Yafeng.

In the previous life, he took care of the princess for ten years. In order to make her practice seriously, he really took care of her daily life like a father. He washed the princess's underwear every day, so let alone these petty hobbies, he even knew that she wore a fixed style of underwear every day from Monday to Saturday.

Ilsa was a little sleepy. She had been in a high-intensity state of tension some time ago. Although the current environment was a bit strange to her, it gave her a rare sense of peace of mind. At least, she didn't have to worry about murderers appearing beside her bed in the middle of her sleep. It seemed that Yafeng wouldn't take action against her for the time being.

For her, her days as an empire princess are coming to an end...

Her eyelids became heavier and she fell asleep quickly.

....

Dimly, she seemed to see Ya Feng, but it was not the same as now.

Instead, he was wearing armor, had long black hair, his eyes were surprisingly resolute and calm, and he treated her with an unquestionable majesty like an elder.

He was not what he looked like now. Instead, he was wearing the robe of a high-ranking magician Fein and had short hair. When facing Ya Feng, he couldn't help but feel nervous. He didn't dare to speak easily. He was filled with awe and loyalty.
